{{Quote|It's so peaceful here… the Force permeates everything.|[[Nomi Sunrider]]|<ref name="nadd1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Ossus''', known as '''Idux''' while under the control of [[Xim/Legends|Xim's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]], was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]] in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]]. Known to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] since before [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] expanded there from the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and established a [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]], Ossus would become a popular world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This world would also become a place of great importance to the Jedi, as the site where they [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|stored]] the sum of their knowledge, though such attentions came at a price. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], catapulting the galaxy into the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], he attacked Ossus, desiring [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] secrets hidden by the Jedi. During the events this action incited, the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] was [[Cron Supernova/Legends|detonated]], spreading a shockwave around the galaxy. Originally a rich, lush world, Ossus was ravaged into an arid and toxic planet when the wave struck the planet.

Certain individuals survived the blast, including several Jedi. Over the passing generations, these people would become more feral, forgetting their heritage and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while regarding their abilities from it as magical. They became the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]], Ossus's only native sentience. They, along with the planet, lived in peace with the rest of the galaxy through the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], when Ossus primarily became a planet of archaeological importance to the Jedi. Once the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose to replace the Republic, such studies into the past of the Jedi were halted, however.

After the eventual fall of that government as well, and the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Ossus saw major use during a time of war, for the first time since the Sith War of [[3996 BBY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] of [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. It was studied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invaders who wished to conquer the galaxy, while they searched for a way to gain the upper hand against their primary enemies, the Jedi and New Republic, who in turn used it as a rally point for assaults against the Yuuzhan Vong. Ossus regained its standing with the Jedi, revived as the [[New Jedi Order]], following the war. Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] reopened the Academy there and made it the headquarters of their organization, though he later returned that distinction to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

In an attempt to allow the Yuuzhan Vong to redeem themselves a century later, Skywalker's descendant, [[Kol Skywalker]], founded the [[Ossus Project]], an initiative to use Yuuzhan Vong [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] to restore the surface of Ossus. Due to [[One Sith|Sith]] sabotage, the project failed and infected many individuals with organic parasites. The devastating effects the parasites had on people prompted the [[Fel Empire]] to call for an end to the project, which the Jedi would not allow. When the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] defended the Yuuzhan Vong at the request of the Jedi, the Empire declared [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] against their loose rival, crippling and defeating them in [[130 ABY]]. The Jedi moved their headquarters to Ossus once again after Coruscant was ceded to the Empire and Sith. However, two days later, the Sith attacked the Ossus Academy, killing half the Jedi inside and beginning the galaxy's [[third Jedi Purge]]. The Empire would later level the entire Academy in a barrage of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire.

==Description==
===Astrography===
Ossus orbited the two stars of the Adega system, [[Adega Prime]] and [[Adega Besh]]. Unlike the other five planets in the system, which circled the center of mass of the two binaries, Ossus orbited both its suns in a figure-eight trajectory. Two moons in turn orbited it: [[Mim]], a rocky, low-gravity satellite with no atmosphere, and [[Nerit]], a temperate terrestrial world with high gravity and a population of [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] expatriates.<ref name="geo" /> Ossus [[Unidentified period (Ossus)|passed]] directly between its two stars twice every year, blasted by radiant energy from opposite sides. During this period, the planet went several weeks without a night, while planetary temperatures skyrocketed, evaporating most of the surface water into clouds.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

It was considered one of the three worlds of sacred importance to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], along with [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Geography===
[[File:Watery_Ossus.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ossus before the cataclysm]]
Ossus was originally a rugged, lush world with two-thirds of its surface covered in water and an abundance of flora and fauna. In [[3996 BBY]] it was transformed with the destruction of the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] into a desolate, irradiated desert world. Chemical and electrical storms swept the land, and little life remained on the surface.<ref name="geo" /> Over 4,000 years later, the damage done to the planet seemed to have been reversed. In the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], some portions of the planet were once again lush with vegetation and inhabited by wildlife.<ref name="Inferno" /> Within a century after this, the destruction done to Ossus was fully reversed with the terraforming biotechnology of Yuuzhan Vong [[Shaper caste|Shapers]], who caused the planet to once again teem with life.<ref name="leg">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>

Before the Cron supernova, Ossus had a population in the hundreds of millions, inhabiting cities across the globe. The principle city was that of [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]], whose [[Knossa Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was the main thoroughfare for arriving and leaving Ossus. The Cron incident destroyed most of the buildings in these cities.<ref name="geo" />

Though a world of peace, Ossus was not a defenseless planet. Scattered ground emplacements protected it from aerial attack. During the various wars with the Sith, Ossus was used as a staging ground for Jedi and Republic forces. The planet also maintained a well-equipped military fleet for defense. Law enforcement consisted of [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]] who maintained security in the cities.<ref name="geo" />

===Flora and fauna===
Ossus had been lush with life before the Cron disaster, but after those events, little of it remained. One of the surviving animals was a hardy quadruped species that the locals used as mounts.<ref name="geo" /> By 40 ABY, however, plant and animal life burgeoned again. The region around the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] was verdant, with small plots of foliage interspersed among stretches of turf making up the Academy's campus, and [[kingwood]] trees covering the lower slopes of the nearby mountains.<ref name="Inferno" /> [[Bambwood]] was also found on this world.<ref name="DN3">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

The forests were also abundant with animal life. [[Gokob]]s, a species of friendly hairless rodents that sprayed a stinking cloud when frightened, spent much of their time scavenging off [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] scraps from the Jedi academy kitchens. Large brightly-colored tree frogs with sticky tongues also inhabited the treetops, and low-flying academy [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] could find themselves with several frogs stuck to their undersides, a hazard to flight.<ref name="Inferno" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|Ossus was the headquarters of the Jedi Order, which had left Tython to distance itself from the machinations of the growing Republic.|[[Arden Lyn]]|<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The unusually stable figure-eight orbit of Ossus caused some to speculate that the planet's orbit was created artificially. However, despite the best efforts of generations of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], no such evidence was ever uncovered.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The planet was home to intelligent life for countless generations.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /> Originally known as Idux, it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="Xim" /> Circa [[25,783 BBY]],<ref name="encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] from [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] established a school of philosophy there where the concepts of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides of the Force]] were laid down. Here, too, the philosophies of the [[The Force/Legends#The Living Force|Living]] and [[The Force/Legends#Potentium and the Unifying Force|Unifying Force]] were established.<ref name="New Essential Chronology" />

Around [[24,953 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Galactic History}} provides 21,300 BTC as the date when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] began in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], which is 1,347 BTC in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', so the difference between the calendar based on the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the calendar based on the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] is 3,653 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. This allows us to place the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] joining the Republic in [[24,953 BBY]].</ref> [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] scouts exploring the newly-discovered [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] arrived on Ossus, in what was then known as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The leader of the [[Jedi Enclave (Ossus)|Jedi Enclave]], Master [[Haune Tiar]] was invited to tour the Republic, and his return on Ossus were followed by several weeks of debate among the Order.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 12: The Birth of the Republic}}</ref> Following these events, the Jedi appointed themselves defenders of the nascent Republic. Ossus was poised to defend the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] against the forces of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] and [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and so the planet became a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] protecting the Perlemian. With the Jedi holding back its enemies, the Republic grew apace.<ref name="New Essential Chronology" />

===Jedi stronghold===
In [[11,933 BBY]], after witnessing the massacres committed against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the first [[Pius Dea Crusades|Pius Dea crusades]], the Jedi Order decided to [[Recusal|sever all ties with the Republic]] and retreat to Ossus.
The Jedi would remain there for the next [[11,100 BBY|eight centuries]], until the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] convinced them to act against the Republic and put an end to the [[Pius Dea]] rule.<ref name="EGW" />

[[File:OodWithShaela.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Shaela Nuur]] trains on Ossus.]]
Several millennia after the fall of the Pius Dea sect and the pacification of the Republic, Ossus had quickly become a leading center of knowledge and learning for the Jedi Order. [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] trained there under the tutelage of [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]], and around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], constructed the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] as a grand repository of Jedi knowledge, containing tens of thousands of texts. Pilgrimages to the world from thousands of planets were common, many of them by Jedi seeking enlightenment. Most Jedi traveled to Ossus at some point in their lives. Academics, too, were drawn to the world, seeking knowledge and research contained nowhere else. Due to its importance to the Jedi, many scholars incorrectly concluded that it had been the birthplace of the Order.<ref name="geo" /> Notable students of Ossus included [[Freedon Nadd]],<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> [[Nomi Sunrider]], [[Dace Diath]], [[Shoaneb Culu]],<ref name="nadd1" /> [[Derrica Praji]],<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}},</ref> and [[Shaela Nuur]].<ref name="Shadows and Light">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref>

This oasis of knowledge and peace was doomed, however. In 3996 BBY,<ref name="New Essential Chronology" /> during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], the reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], slew Odan-Urr, stole a [[Dark Holocron|Sith holocron]],<ref name="TSW1" /> and recruited [[Brotherhood of the Sith|many Jedi students]] on Ossus to the dark side, taking them to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref> Under Kun's orders, [[Aleema Keto]] and [[Crado]] used Sith weaponry from [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] ancient battleship, the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], to [[Cron Supernova/Legends|detonate]] the stars of the nearby Cron Cluster, causing a deadly shock-wave to spread out across space.<ref name="TSW4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 4]]</ref>

[[File:OssusEvacuation.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi evacuate the doomed Ossus.]]
The Jedi were forced to hastily evacuate the planet, and it was during the ensuing chaos that Kun [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|returned]] with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] and a team of [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors, determined to loot the planet of its riches. Qel-Droma's [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] dived into the fray too, firing on the ships of the fleeing Jedi. Kun attempted to take a valuable collection of ancient [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], but was stopped by the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]]. Bnar transformed himself into a tree, trapping the lightsabers underneath his roots and preventing Kun from reaching them.<ref name="TOTJTSW5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref>

Ulic, meanwhile, engaged in battle with his brother [[Cay Qel-Droma|Cay]], who sought to turn him back from the dark side. When Ulic struck down his brother in a fit of rage,<ref name="TOTJTSW5" /> Nomi Sunrider, horrified at what he had done, stripped him of the Force, and the Jedi took him prisoner and fled the doomed planet. The shock-wave hit soon afterward, searing Ossus and killing much of its life.<ref name="TOTJTSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>

===Post-Great Sith War===
{{Quote|An ancient bastion of the Jedi Order. The Sith reduced it to a barren wasteland centuries ago.|[[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:IP">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=faction|Republic|Inflection Point|Odessen}}</ref>}}
The planet was not completely scoured of life, however. [[Jedi survivors (Ossus)/Legends|Some Jedi]] had found protection in the [[Crystal Caves (Ossus)/Legends|Crystal Caves]] under the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]].<ref name="NoP" /> Over time, their descendants forgot their origins, and came to see their Force abilities as a form of magic. As life slowly crept back onto the world, they emerged to become the tribal Ysanna. Ood Bnar survived as well, protected from the full effect of the supernova in his new form. In order to protect ancient lightsabers, Ood used the force to transform into a tree. His roots covered the lightsabers and protected them.<ref name="geo" /><ref name="TEA" /> The Cron Cluster's destruction into the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] made [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel to the world nearly impossible.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Ossus_TOR.png|thumb|right|250px|Ossus at the time of the Eternal Empire]]
Most of the knowledge of the Jedi stored on Ossus was lost forever in the cataclysm. However, much was moved as well, to locations as far spread as [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]], the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Derem City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. The Jedi learned from the disaster, and built storehouses in planets across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to hold their most valuable artifacts.<ref name="geo" /> Contingency plans for evacuation were established in case other important Jedi worlds such as [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] were attacked.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

Sometime after the end of the [[Galactic War]], Ossus became home to a [[Jedi Colony|colony]] of Jedi who had fled the onslaught of the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] by [[Arcann]] and [[Vaylin]], led by Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]]. The Jedi on the planet had established a small colony and worked to recover lost knowledge housed in Ossus' temples and library.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> At one point multiple Jedi, led by Gnost-Dural, attempted to revive [[Ood Bnar]], who was still entranced in a state of deep hibernation after the Cron Supernova.<ref name="Bnar Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Ood Bnar}}</ref> In [[3628 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post-Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sent forces under [[Darth Malora]] to Ossus in a [[Invasion of Ossus|pre-emptive strike]] against the Republic. The Republic responded with forces under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|Daerunn]], and the colony of Jedi was evacuated. However, the conflict resulted in the reawakening of [[Darth Malgus]], who had survived the events following the [[Battle of Ilum]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

Ossus was a popular location for archaeological teams during the time of the Old Republic. The [[Hanna Institute of Antiquities/Legends|Hanna Institute of Antiquities]], [[Academy of Jedi Archaeology]], and [[University of Agamar]] all sponsored studies and excavations of the ancient ruins.<ref name="geo" /> In [[800 BBY/Legends|800 BBY]], a dig recovered a [[Vima-Da-Boda's lightsaber|lightsaber]] that would eventually belong to [[Vima-Da-Boda]].<ref name="Dark Empire endnotes">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref>

[[File:Lightning_strikes_Ossus_NoP.png|thumb|left|250px|A lightning storm rages across the barren surface of Ossus]]
Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], several Jedi were dispatched to defend Ossus. A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[First battle of Ossus|offensive]] struck, and the planet fell within days of the [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|Battle of Rhen Var]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars video game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> The CIS established a base on the planet, which was later the target of a [[Battle of Ossus (Outer Rim Sieges)|Republic attack]] as one of the opening battles of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="New Essential Chronology" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came into power, its crackdown on Jedi-related activity brought research to a stop. Extremely few projects on Ossus were funded on the Empire's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]], and private organizations who wanted to do research had to avoid incurring its wrath.<ref name="geo" /> Ossus' legacy as a forgotten repository of Jedi knowledge served to inspire [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]] survivor [[Jin-Lo Rayce]] to name his fledgling group of [[Force Adept]]s the [[Agents of Ossus]], keeping the history of the Jedi hidden, rather than lost.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], [[Travgen]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], found Ossus and hid there from the Empire. Establishing himself in an old administrative center, he eventually rose to control several Ysanna tribes, and was still living on Ossus during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era.<ref name="Corellia Antilles" />

===Rediscovery===
[[File:OssusRuins.jpg|250px|thumb|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kam Solusar]] visit Ossus.]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kam Solusar]] arrived on Ossus in search of Jedi artifacts to aid in rebuilding the Order, guided there by an ancient holocron of [[Bodo Baas]]. Searching the ancient ruins, they encountered a pair of Ysanna, [[Jem Ysanna|Jem]], and [[Rayf Ysanna|Rayf]], who they sensed were Force-sensitive. The two Jedi were then ambushed by a band of Ysanna, whose primitive Force-enhanced attacks they easily blocked. Knowing from their strength in the Force that they could only be Jedi, the Ysanna welcomed the two men.<ref name="de2">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref>

This new allegiance was immediately put to the test. The Galactic Empire had tracked Luke and Kam's approach to the planet, and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Side Elite]] [[Sedriss QL]] and [[Vill Goir]] were dispatched to capture or kill them. The Ysanna and Jedi [[Skirmish on Ossus|fought off their soldiers]], and Solusar killed Goir. Sedriss took Jem hostage, and backed up against a tree. However, this tree turned out to be the dormant Ood Bnar, who came to life and killed Sedriss, sacrificing himself in the process. Underneath him Luke discovered the ancient cache of lightsabers, which he took to be a sign of the Jedi's return. The Ysanna then revealed to the Jedi the secret location of the Great Jedi Library, which still held some undamaged texts. Before leaving, Kam and Luke asked the Ysanna if any wished to be Jedi candidates; only Jem and Rayf accepted.<ref name="de2" />

[[File:DEOssusLibrary.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].]]
In the wake of Palpatine's subsequent attacks on the New Republic with the [[Galaxy Gun]], its leaders sought a new safe haven. Solusar suggested Ossus, believing that Palpatine would not risk destroying such a valuable repository of Jedi knowledge. The Jedi returned to the planet to ask the Ysanna, and encountered the forces of the Empire, sent by Palpatine to seize several Ysanna to clone and use as host bodies. The Jedi arrived too late to stop them from leaving Ossus, but rescued the captured Ysanna later on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].<ref name="ee1" /> With the destruction of the Galaxy Gun,<ref name="ee2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref> the New Republic no longer needed a hidden base, and therefore never relocated to the world.<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>

It was not forgotten, however. The New Republic and New Jedi Order began an extensive archaeological survey of the planet, unearthing its ancient ruins and learning more about the Jedi of old. The [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]], Hanna Institute of Antiquities, and [[New Republic Archaeological Corps]], as well as groups from across the galaxy sponsored excavations on Ossus.<ref name="geo" /> Though they learned much of the planet, the scholars did not fully understand its history; for example, the idea that the Krath had been responsible for the original cataclysm was not taken seriously in academia.<ref name="Corellia Antilles" /> The Jedi took a particular interest, as Luke Skywalker believed it was necessary to understand the past of the Jedi before attempting to build a new future for them. The Ysanna grew more accepting of the Jedi, and it was expected that in time they would seek out their Jedi heritage again.<ref name="geo" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the New Republic [[Historical Council]] noted that some said that the Jedi Order began on Ossus,<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> but by [[36 ABY]] they had learned that the Jedi Order actually began on Tython.<ref name="New Essential Chronology" />

Ossus stood outside the invasion corridor of the Yuuzhan Vong, and so avoided the widespread destruction of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. However, all official research was brought to a halt by the war. Yuuzhan Vong occasionally [[Mission to Ossus|visited]] the planet in search of ancient secrets that could help them exterminate the Jedi. The New Republic, too, used Ossus, taking advantage of its proximity to Yuuzhan Vong territory to send strike teams into enemy-held sectors.<ref name="geo" />

===New Jedi Order===
[[File:OssusJediTemple-2006Legacy1.jpg|thumb|250px|The [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|new Jedi academy]].]]
At the close of the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Jedi chose to distance themselves from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] on Coruscant. With the [[Jedi Praxeum|praxeum]] at Yavin 4 destroyed, Luke Skywalker chose Ossus as the new home of the Jedi Order, on the suggestion of Kam Solusar. Not all Jedi moved there at first; Solusar, his wife [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]], Luke, [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and their son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] were amongst those who did.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> The Solusars became the administrators of the Ossus academy. A [[new Jedi Temple]] was built on Coruscant, but its use was chiefly formal, to facilitate communication and cooperation with the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="tjk">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

During the [[Gorog|Dark Nest]] crisis and subsequent [[Swarm War]], the Order used Ossus as their principle base of operations. In 36 ABY, Luke Skywalker called a [[Conclave on Ossus|meeting]] of the entire Jedi Order to resolve the crisis he saw facing it. He reconfirmed the Jedi's commitment to the Galactic Alliance and made an ultimatum to those present; they would put their commitment to the Jedi before all else, or they would resign from the Order. He also established himself as [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Order in a bid to make the Masters put aside their differences in the face of his apparent power grab.<ref name="DN3" />

===Galactic Alliance troubles===
When [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] seized control of the Galactic Alliance government in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], he knew that the Jedi would oppose his rule. When most of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] left Ossus to attend the [[funeral of Mara Jade Skywalker]] on Coruscant, leaving only Kam and Tionne Solusar and a handful of Knights, Jacen seized his chance and sent a Galactic Alliance Guard division to take control of the academy. Led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Salle Serpa]], the GAG group claimed to be taking these actions for the protection of the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] still in the academy, though their true purpose was to hold the Padawans hostage and prevent Jedi opposition to Jacen.<ref name="Inferno" />

Shortly thereafter, the Dark Jedi [[Alema Rar]] came to Ossus in search of records that would help her understand her new [[Sith Meditation Sphere]]. A task force consisting of [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Jagged Fel]], and [[Zekk]] soon followed her there, only to find Serpa in control of the academy. They, like all the other Jedi there, were forced to play along while the Padawans were still under threat, as Serpa intimated that he would gladly destroy the academy if he felt it was a threat. Alema found the information she sought and left the planet, but her pursuers were forced to remain behind.<ref name="Inferno" />

Events would change soon, though. Following the assassination of [[Cal Omas]], the Jedi cut their ties to the Galactic Alliance. Jacen Solo, declaring that the Jedi had betrayed them, decided that he needed to take control of the Padawans, and ordered the execution of the Masters and Knights. Serpa rounded up the Padawans in an outdoor courtyard and positioned snipers to take out the Jedi who showed themselves. Several Knights were killed in the conflict, several Padawans were wounded or killed, and Kam and Tionne Solusar were grievously injured, the latter personally by Serpa. Jaina and Jagged were able to avoid the GAG patrols, however, and between them and Zekk, the GAG troops were eliminated and Serpa was captured. The other GAG troopers surrendered, some because they had been opposed to Serpa's actions, others out of fear of the Jedi.<ref name="Inferno" /> After the attack, the Jedi abandoned Ossus and relocated for a time to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

Following the conclusion of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] and the demise of [[Lumiya's Sith]] in [[41 ABY]], the Jedi Order did not immediately return to Ossus, instead electing to remain in their temporary [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|Academy]] on [[Shedu Maad]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

===Resurgent Sith===
Sometime between [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] and [[130 ABY]], the Galactic Alliance and the Jedi allowed the [[Shaper caste]] of the Yuuzhan Vong to terraform the barren planet and restore it to its original beauty. A desolate part of the planet was chosen to test the Yuuzhan Vong biotechnology. Championed by [[Kol Skywalker]] and run by [[Master Shaper]] [[Nei Rin]], the [[Ossus Project]] was a major success and soon, many planets turned to the Yuuzhan Vong to terraform their own planets.<ref name="leg" /><ref name="Ghosts 2">[[Legacy (2006) 12|''Legacy'' (2006) 12]]</ref>

However, sabotage by the [[One Sith]] eventually led to the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. In the wake of the war, the Galactic Alliance fell and the Empire ascended to power. The Jedi, refusing to follow the Empire and its Sith allies, retreated to Ossus.<ref name="leg" /> Nei Rin and several Yuuzhan Vong went to Ossus too, to study their work and find what had gone wrong on the project. The planet, however, had not been affected by any of the mutations that had occurred on other worlds.<ref name="Ghosts 2" />

[[File:Ossus_Exterior.jpg|thumb|250px|Ossus after the Vongforming.]]
The Sith, in league with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]], then [[Massacre at Ossus|attacked]] the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, and two days later struck again at Ossus. Amongst the Ossus Academy's defenders were Kol Skywalker, his son [[Cade Skywalker|Cade]], [[Wolf Sazen]], and [[Shado Vao]]. On Kol's urging, Cade escaped the planet on a [[J-1 shuttle|shuttle]] full of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]. Kol later fell to [[Darth Nihl]], and most of the remaining Jedi on Ossus were slaughtered. Because the Sith attacked before all the Jedi could gather there, however, about half of them escaped and went into hiding throughout the galaxy. Cade, meanwhile, helped defend the shuttle from the Sith with his [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter|fighter]], but when it was destroyed, he was forced to eject and was left behind.<ref name="Legacy 2006 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> Cade was later rescued by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Rav]] and his crew, and to spare his own life, Cade offered to show the pirates where the Temple's treasures were kept, claiming he was a scavenger who knew his way around Ossus. With Cade's help, Rav's crew looted the Temple and departed Ossus. The Empire later set up a watch on Ossus and routinely scanned the Temple for life. Rin and her warriors, who had been on Ossus but away from the Temple at the time of the attack, took refuge beneath the Temple, where they guarded a trove of Jedi artifacts.<ref name="Ghosts 2" />

===Jedi in hiding===
[[File:Ossusacademy-destruction.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Stryfe destroys the Jedi Temple.]]
In [[137 ABY]], Cade Skywalker returned to Ossus. Imperial agent [[Morrigan Corde]]—secretly Cade's mother—and Sith agent [[Jor Torlin]] later arrived in search of him, but when Tol attempted to betray Corde, she killed him instead. Not wanting to see Cade again, Corde soon left the planet.<ref name="Legacy 2006 10">[[Legacy (2006) 10|''Legacy'' (2006) 10]]</ref> Cade was later found by Jedi Master [[K'Kruhk]], who had also been in hiding on the world. Along with fellow Jedi [[Wolf Sazen]] and [[Shado Vao]], who had recently returned to Ossus expecting to find Cade, K'Kruhk helped Cade complete his Jedi training. During a sparring session, Cade and Shado discovered beneath the Temple Nei Rin and her Yuuzhan Vong, and the lost vault of Jedi treasure they guarded.<ref name="Legacy 2006 11">[[Legacy (2006) 11|''Legacy'' (2006) 11]]</ref>

Cade later left the world for Coruscant, while the other Jedi and the Yuuzhan Vong stayed behind.<ref name="Ghosts 2" /> However, they would not be left at peace. Someone in the Empire suspected that Jedi may have been hiding on Ossus, and [[Darth Stryfe]] was dispatched to the world. [[Joker Squad]] conducted a search of the surface, but found nothing, as the Jedi and Yuuzhan Vong had gone into hiding. Nonetheless, Stryfe felt a stirring in the Force, and ordered the search to continue.<ref name="Legacy 2006 16">[[Legacy (2006) 16|''Legacy'' (2006) 16]]</ref> The stormtrooper patrols at last left the planet, some having found no one, some having encountered the Jedi, but been [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] to believe otherwise. Stryfe still sensed a Jedi presence, though, and ordered the destruction of the Temple. His [[Unidentified Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|vessel]] opened fire, leveling the building.<ref name="Legacy 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>

==Inhabitants==
[[File:YsannaNomadOnBeast.jpg|250px|thumb|A [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] nomad riding a beast.]]
Ossus was inhabited by intelligent life for unnumbered generations. In the days of the Old Republic before the Cron cataclysm, the planet's inhabitants were largely Jedi or other students of the Force. There was a large population of academics and scholars as well, taking advantage of the Order's tremendous wealth of knowledge. Members of nearly every species in the Republic could be found there. During times of war, the planet also played host to Republic soldiers, who used it as a staging ground to launch offensives into enemy space.<ref name="geo" />

The supernova, however, changed this. Many of those who did not evacuate in time were killed when the shockwave hit. Those who had taken shelter in mountain caverns managed to eke out an existence on the now-barren planet. In time, they became the nomadic Ysanna tribes. Nearly all Ysanna felt the Force, but they were untrained, and their use of it was weak. However, it was enough to give them an advantage in their harsh environment, particularly in guiding the projectiles from their weapons to strike more accurately. A species of massive, hardy quadrupeds had survived the disaster too, and the Ysanna trained them as mounts. They adorned themselves in ritual masks based on artifacts of the dark side they had uncovered from the ruins of the Great Library. Though they had forgotten the specifics of their Jedi ancestors, they still held the ruins of the Order in reverence.<ref name="geo" />

Other inhabitants arrived on Ossus in the intervening years, including those stranded by shipwrecks and the occasional squatter. Travgen, one of those who had chosen to come to Ossus, believed visitors to Ossus to be a threat to him, and attempted to scare off expeditions to the world. He did not, however, interfere with Luke Skywalker when he came, and was relieved when Skywalker left the planet.<ref name="Corellia Antilles" /> With the rediscovery of Ossus in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] and the eventual establishment of a new Jedi academy there, the planet once more became populated with Jedi. The Ysanna continued their lifestyle much as it was, now hosts to visitors from across the galaxy. Some Ysanna chose to join the Jedi and learn the ways of the Force.<ref name="geo" /> Less than half the Jedi in the Order were living on Ossus at the time of the Empire's attack in 130 ABY.<ref name="Legacy 2006 8">[[Legacy (2006) 8|''Legacy'' (2006) 8]]</ref> In the time of the Ossus Project, Yuuzhan Vong warriors and shapers lived on Ossus as well. Almost all of them were killed in the attack on the Temple.<ref name="Ghosts 2" />

==Locations==
===Knossa===
{{Main|Knossa/Legends}}
[[File:GreatJediLibrary_EGTF.jpg|thumb|250px|The Eye of Ashlanae in Knossa]]
Knossa, located on a slope of the Eocho Mountains in the far south, was the primary city on Ossus and contained the planet's largest spaceport. It held the usual venues to be found in cities, including repair bays, restaurants, and lodging, and was also host to a number of research facilities for visiting academics.<ref name="geo" />

Knossa's central plaza held two important obelisks topped with [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. When the moons of Ossus aligned with the crystals, they produced a famous and magnificent display of light. The Jedi held this time to be sacred, and used it to remember those of their Order who had fallen in combat. It is from this that the term [[Ossus Day]] originated.<ref name="geo" />

===Great Jedi Library===
{{Main|Great Jedi Library/Legends}}
[[File:GreatLibraryOnOssus.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Great Jedi Library.]]
Built by Odan-Urr in 5000 BBY,<ref name="ECdate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' says that the events of [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]] happened in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> the Library was a great storehouse of Jedi knowledge, containing over ten thousand works.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /> Located on a hill in the [[Ooroo Canyon/Legends|Ooroo Canyon]],<ref name="NoP" /> the Library was a large, unadorned stone building with many of its rooms located below ground. Its entrances were unbarred, as Odan-Urr did not believe in fettering any being's search for knowledge.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /> Though it was built for Jedi purposes, the Library held information on all subjects, not simply Jedi affairs, and access was granted to any individual who wished to learn.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 87">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 87|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 87]]</ref>

Most data were stored in the main building, in a labyrinthine system of shelves. Reading rooms and classrooms filled the lower levels, as well as holograms of some of the most treasured contents of the library. Four towers held relics from the four main eras of history, as per Odan-Urr's dating system: [[Pre-Hyperdrive]], [[Pre-Republic era|Pre-Republic]], Early Republic, and Mature Republic. More dangerous artifacts were stored deep underground, in the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]]. Only those with permission from the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and [[Keeper of Antiquities]] were permitted down there.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

The Library's dense construction was likely what allowed it to survive the Cron supernova. Its location was lost until Rayf Ysanna's great-grandfather rediscovered it. He kept it a secret, not wanting the sacred ruins to be disturbed. Rayf revealed the library's location to Luke Skywalker on the Jedi's first visit to Ossus. The ancient secrets of the Jedi it still held were invaluable to Luke and his cause of rebuilding the shattered Order.<ref name="de2 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>

===Jedi Academy===
{{Main|Jedi Academy (Ossus)}}
Located in a lush benchland between a mountain and a rift valley, and covering a wide expanse of land,<ref name="Inferno" /> the Ossus academy was the new nerve center of the Jedi Order after the Yuuzhan Vong War, replacing the destroyed [[Jedi Praxeum]] on Yavin 4. It was designed with meditation in mind; difficult paths between the buildings forced Jedi to focus on their surroundings and rooms in the Temple were arranged in a way that encouraged serenity.<ref name="tjk" />

Amongst the Academy's facilities was a massive lecture hall, a library, a hangar, training grounds, and laboratories. The grounds were staffed by Jedi, families of Jedi, and Ysanna.<ref name="tjk" /> After it was attacked by the Sith and Empire, the Temple was left to the scavengers, who took many of its Jedi artifacts. Some Jedi and Yuuzhan Vong hid within it in later years.<ref name="Ghosts 2" /> It was destroyed by Darth Stryfe in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 17" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Dark Empire endnotes|endnotes]] included with [[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]], where Ossus was first mentioned, say that Ossus was mysteriously abandoned circa [[7000 BBY]] and decayed into ruins in the years after. The version of the endnotes included in the 1st and 2nd editions of the [[Star Wars: Dark Empire (TPB)|''Dark Empire'' trade paperback]] gives the correct date of approximately [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="Dark Empire endnotes" /> It would not be until [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]] that Ossus would appear in a ''[[Star Wars]]'' work.<ref name="nadd1" />
